articles.title: Frequently Asked Questions
articles.summary: Quick answers to the questions every new user asks.

beginner.text: Quick answers, with links to the full articles.

faq.q: Why don't I see a confirmation when something succeeds?
faq.a: Deliberate design: the extension only notifies on errors. No toast means it worked. The exceptions are flows that show explicit progress, like date saves and bulk sends.

faq.q: Why did Send open an Outlook window?
faq.a: Power Automate is off (the default) or has no flow URL, so sending falls back to a pre-filled Outlook window. See 'How Email Sending Works'.

faq.q: Does anyone else see my Watch List, templates, or settings?
faq.a: Local data stays in your browser profile unless you explicitly create a settings link. RevStack stores only the scopes you select; Watch List data and credentials are never included.

faq.q: Are 3D previews accurate enough to send to customers?
faq.a: Yes — decorations render through the same production services the website uses, and exports use a fixed pose so every shot frames identically.

faq.q: What's the difference between the Watch List and Quick Tasks?
faq.a: Watch List is your private local to-do list; nothing reaches the CRM. Quick Task creates a real CRM task attached to the contact, visible to the team.

faq.q: Why does the Gift Catalog take a few seconds sometimes?
faq.a: It's re-indexing the full site catalog — happens when the local cache (24h) expires. Subsequent opens are instant.

faq.q: Will a campaign email people twice if I run it again?
faq.a: A campaign processes the audience you select per run. Re-running on the same selection sends again — use saved queries to define audiences precisely, and dry-run first.

faq.q: Did 'reply with template' send my email?
faq.a: Power Automate sends directly and reports success or failure. When Power Automate is off, the extension opens a pre-filled Outlook window and you finish the send there.

faq.q: A toggle disappeared from my Settings — am I losing my mind?
faq.a: No — the authenticated administrator policy can hide managed controls. Ask a RevStack administrator to review the Golfballs configuration.

beginner.text: Highlights from recent updates. Minor fixes are omitted.

highlights: Proposals are now tracked server-side exactly like web quotes — sending creates the proposal email record, registers tracking, and updates the opportunity value.
Promo codes: apply real promotions to proposals, including free-quantity promos with genuine free-item lines; the picker only offers codes that apply to your cart.
Current Proposals sidebar: see a contact's existing proposals live from the CRM — open the breakdown, load one back into the builder, or re-email it.
Costs & inventory: bulk cost sync, auto-loading costs in breakdowns, editable per-split prices, and real-cost labels.
Proposal emails are now Outlook-desktop safe (solid colors, no dropped styling).
Themes: new Slate variant (Atom One Dark) alongside Dark, Light, and Cream.
